items.scope:
Root Scope: Japan organizations.
CNA Scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.

All Cisco products, and any third-party research targets that are not in another CNA’s scope. Cisco will not issue a CVE ID for issues reported on products that are past the Last Day of Support milestone, as defined on Cisco’s End-of-Life Policy, which is available at https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/eos-eol-policy.html.
All Centreon product issues only.
MongoDB products only, not including end-of-life components or products.
Azure Access branded products and technologies only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by DIVD, and vulnerabilities reported to DIVD for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
All rami.io GmbH products and open source projects, including pretix, official pretix plugins and apps, and Venueless.
Vulnerabilities in software published and maintained by Progress Software Corporation.
Core Joomla! CMS, the Joomla Framework, and Joomla! Extensions issues only.
Supermicro branded products, managed system, or software projects.
All Cloudflare products, projects hosted at https://github.com/cloudflare/, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Cloudflare that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All HCL products only.

Meta-supported open source projects, mobile apps, and other software, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Meta that are not in another CNA’s scope; see: https://www.facebook.com/whitehat and https://github.com/facebook/.
Symantec Enterprise products as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Symantec that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All products and projects in which OpenVPN is directly involved commercially and for OpenVPN community projects, including Private Tunnel.
All GE Vernova products.
Huawei issues only.

Any code repository hosted under gerrit.wikimedia.org, gitlab.wikimedia.org, or github.com/wikimedia that is not labeled as archived or marked as a fork of an upstream project. Please see our disclosure policy for additional exclusions to scope.
TIBCO issues only.
Gitea issues only.
Vulnerabilities in the KoreLogic website and other KoreLogic controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to KoreLogic, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
OpenSSL software projects only.
Oracle supported version product issues only; CVE IDs will not be assigned for unsupported products or versions (Oracle will confirm support status and notify researcher).
postgresql.org/download software and related projects listed at postgresql.org/support/security.
Products and services provided by Open-Xchange, PowerDNS, and Dovecot.

Root Scope: European Union (EU) member states/EU authorities, EU CSIRTs network members, and cooperative partners under ENISA’s mandate as well as other CNAs who choose ENISA as their Root.

CNA Scope: Vulnerabilities in information technology (IT) products discovered by European Union (EU) Computer Security Incident Response Teams (CSIRTs) or reported to EU CSIRTs for coordinated disclosure, as long as they do not fall under a CNA with a more specific scope.
VMware, Spring, and Cloud Foundry issues only.
NetScaler issues only.
All vulnerabilities discovered in third-party hardware/software by SEC Consult Vulnerability Lab (part of SEC Consult, an Eviden business), which are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Perforce products.

Vulnerabilities found in Securin products and services (including end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Securin that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Salesforce products only.
Vulnerabilities in Mandiant products or discovered by Mandiant while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Octopus Deploy products, as well as Octopus Deploy maintained projects hosted on https://github.com/OctopusDeploy.

Vulnerabilities in Perl and CPAN Modules (including End-of-Life Perl versions) found at https://perl.org, https://cpan.org, or https://metacpan.org/, excluding distributions of Perl or CPAN Modules maintained by third-party redistributors.
All Apache Software Foundation issues only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-NL, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-NL for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA's scope.
All Grafana Labs open source and commercial products.
Unisoc issues only.
All Atlassian products, as well as Atlassian-maintained projects hosted on https://bitbucket.org/ and https://github.com/atlassian/.
All projects hosted under drupal.org, including End of Life (EOL) code.
SonicWall issues only.
All Devolutions products only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by Patchstack and Patchstack Bug Bounty program unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Security issues and vulnerabilities in the GNU C Library.
All products made and managed by the curl project. This includes curl, libcurl, and trurl.
Absolute issues only.
Vulnerabilities reported to CSA unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Arm-branded products and technologies and Arm-managed open source projects.
